The awestruck boy has since grown up and become the executive chef behind Journey, the signature 11-course tasting experience at Urchin Restaurant at the Hyatt Regency in Cape Town.This is where chef Gericke is creating his own take on elegant South African cuisine, inspired by some of the Western Cape’s tastes.Named Africa’s Best Fine Dining Experience and South Africa’s Best Culinary Experience at the 2026 World Culinary Awards, Journey is a personal exploration of the places...
